ekr.views.ProjectGraph/outcome/not-found.purpose: `ekr.views.ProjectGraph` answers `not-found` for the cause it declares as external, injected

ekr.views.ProjectGraph/outcome/not-seede.purpose: `ekr.views.ProjectGraph` answers `not-seeded` for the cause it declares as external, injected

ekr.views.ProjectGraph/outcome/projected.purpose: `ekr.views.ProjectGraph` answers `projected` for an input no other branch's guard claims

ekr.views/authored/a-retracted-assertion.purpose: An assertion added at revision 1 and retracted at revision 2 is absent at 0, Active at 1, and Retracted but still projected at 2.

ekr.views/authored/a-revision-beyond-the.purpose: A store at head 0 projects revision 0 when asked for it by number, and refuses revision 1 as not found, naming the request and the head.

ekr.views/authored/a-schema-evolution-pr.purpose: After one schema change the newest projection lists two versions and version 1's ontology, and a projection at revision 0 lists one version and version 0's ontology at head 1.

ekr.views/authored/a-seed-only-store-pro.purpose: A store holding only its seed projects revision 0 at head 0, with one schema version, one revision entry and no transaction id.

ekr.views/authored/an-assertion-about-an.purpose: The one assertion whose subject is an edge is projected under that edge.

ekr.views/authored/seeded-evidence-is-pr.purpose: All three evidence records a seed admits are projected, and all three as retained.
